text:
Jordan: Heads up — PR #4820 triggered the eval CI and all quant-smoke jobs failed on our self-hosted runners. Looks like container init / runtime errors across the board.

gha-bot: job eval/quant-smoke (self-hosted, linux) failed — https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/4820#run-logs — exit_code=126 :warning:

Sam: suspecting the base image bump from debian:11 -> debian:12 in runner hook. Saw a few 'cannot execute binary file' traces for /opt/runner/bin/kv-cache.

Nina: can you paste the smallest failing log snippet? :eyes:

Jordan: sure — pasted from run log:
```
OCI runtime exec failed: container_linux.go:345: exec: "/bin/bash": stat /bin/bash: no such file or directory
2026-03-10T15:01:23Z containerd: starting container: exit status 126
error: failed to execute /opt/runner/bin/kv-cache: Exec format error
```

Maya: hmm that looks like the container image we used for the runner hook doesn't include /bin/bash. Recent app image was slimmed. Might be missing glibc / correct arch. Could be that kv-cache was built for musl or different arch.

Alex: quick reproduction steps I ran locally: `docker run --rm -it ourregistry/runner-hook:latest /bin/bash` -> fails with same stat error. So image trimmed down. Two options: pin to ubuntu:22.04 or build kv-cache as a static binary.

Sam: to triage fast I'm going to push a temporary workflow change to pin container to ubuntu:22.04 and add a debug dump step (ldd + uname). Patch snippet I'm going to apply: 
```
jobs:
  eval:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x86_64]
    container:
      image: ubuntu:22.04
    steps:
      - name: Dump runner env
        run: |
          uname -a
          ldd /opt/runner/bin/kv-cache || true
          file /opt/runner/bin/kv-cache || true
          ls -la /opt/runner
```

ci-bot: rerun requested by @Maya — enabling debug logs and artifact upload. Debug bundle will be uploaded to s3://redwood-eval-artifacts/4820/debug-3034567890.tgz

Jordan: thanks. Two asks: 1) keep PR gating unaffected — don't block merges on quant-smoke for small infra experiments, and 2) set up fallback to Buildkite smoke pool for quant-smoke until we stabilize.

Maya: agree. I'll add a conditional in the GH workflow: if self-hosted label missing or container init failure -> `workflow_dispatch` Buildkite fallback. Pseudocode: 
```
if: failure('container_init')
then: repository_dispatch -> buildkite-smoke-pool
```

Alex: Also adding a healthcheck step in the runner hook image to fail fast on missing /bin/bash or incompatible libc so future bumps don't silently break.

Sam: pushing PR now -> will pin the container, add dump steps, and a short `if: always()` step to upload the raw runner logs.

Jordan: awesome. once patch is up, can someone trigger a rerun and report back? :thumbsup:

Nina: on it, will rerun when PR lands and paste the new logs here.

Sam: PR filed: github.com/redwood-inference/.github/pull/233 — includes pin + debug steps + artifact upload. Triggered a manual rerun.

gha-bot: rerun started for run id 4821 (invoked by Sam) — debug mode ON.

ci-bot: debug artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-eval-artifacts/4821/debug-3034568025.tgz — includes `ldd`, `file`, env dump, runner logs.

Jordan: scanned artifacts — kv-cache is an x86_64 ELF linked to glibc 2.38; the slim image used musl. That explains the Exec format/ldd weirdness.

Maya: plan: 1) pin container to ubuntu:22.04 for the next release, 2) rebuild kv-cache as static or publish a musl-compatible build, 3) add fallback routing to Buildkite for quant-smoke gating. I'll open follow-ups on infra and build pipelines.

Alex: created infra ticket #1217 to add fast healthchecks to runner images and publish multi-arch kv-cache artifacts.

Jordan: perfect — thanks everyone. Will hold off on merging any quant-model onboarding PRs until the fallback is in place. :lock:
